source_score_selection: For each preregistered role down_proj, k_proj, v_proj: choose argmax and argmin (Q4 squared-gradient directional proxy − n8 squared-gradient directional proxy) across exact 28 layers, smallest index breaks ties; fixed before evaluation.
selection: SHA256(datasetRevision+'/test/'+original_article_id+'/'+original_question) ascending; first eligible 16 with distinct article IDs, complete untruncated article+question+four original answers, exact Qwen ChatML assistant prefix 18..208, and distinct single-token A/B/C/D
native_counterfactual: Every arm uses the same 28-layer source BF16 Qwen weights; allQ4 uses original Qv5 base binary; intervention arms use a separately compiled copy of original Qv5 mixed native C with exactly one modified mask-cardinality guard: 28->1, other C kernel/model code unchanged. Each arm is 1 QNg64-n8 projection and 195 Q4, with equal weights/inputs.
native_source_restriction: Qv5 mixed source SHA pinned, patched exactly cardinality guard and its two log messages; all q4/n8 original kernel support objects and original 196 model topology unchanged, no main/operational writes
predicted_measure: All six Qv6 128 source Fisher gains strictly positive for changing isolated Q4 tensor to n8; high vs low contrast ratio per role tests monotonic alignment with actual end-to-end NLL change, not a calibrated NLL prediction. Correlation across n=6 exploratory with no significance claims.
primary_actual_measure: For every question, actual fullmodel correct single-token NLL under full vocabulary normalization, difference (one_n8−allQ4); secondary A/B/C/D accuracy and exact n8=1/q4=195 log count
statistical_plan: Same 16 distinct articles, within-role high vs low on matched questions; bootstrap B=5000 seed 20261023 NLL differences, Spearman source gain vs observed NLL recovery, nonparametric paired signs; descriptive only
evaluation_limitations: Only 16 public test questions and six cherry-stratified extreme tensors selected source-only; RACE test is not private model-pretraining-unseen; estimates are noisy and not independent cross-model performance. Singleton n8 masks violate 28-n8 target budget but give true local interventions at varying memory overhead; do not conflate effects with feasible global 28bit allocator.
causal_interpretation: Each n8 intervention differs from allQ4 in exactly one projection tensor quantized code in the original BEGLIN C architecture, so measured delta is a one-tensor end-to-end intervention at fixed inputs/model, not necessarily causal attribution to source proxy or broader task distribution.
operational_policy: Never merge to main, change immutable Tailnet Commander operator release, automatic live precision routing, or on-device GPU. Preserve original Qv5 C and all old masks.
pass_gate: 6 independently source-selected singleton-native C arms + allQ4 score 16 questions, SHA-backed original binary and native logs, negative-case audits; source proxy ranking is evaluated against exact actual native NLL and conclusion retained even if negative
